info.description:
This document describes the PagerDuty REST APIs.

For guides and examples please visit our [Documentation.](https://developer.pagerduty.com/docs/get-started/getting-started/)

Our REST APIs are defined in OpenAPI v3.x. You can view the schema at [github.com/PagerDuty/api-schema](https://github.com/PagerDuty/api-schema).

Note that properties in some schemas have fields not shown by default such as `readOnly`, `format`, and `default`. Hover your cursor over the right column that looks like `optional+1` to see the full list of fields.

> **Important note:** Shift-based schedules use the V3 API and are not compatible with V2 automations. **To create automations for Shift-Based Schedules, you need to:**
>
> 1. **Update your automations** to use the V3 API for all new shift-based schedules
> 2. **Keep the V2 endpoint** for your existing schedules
>
> An upgrade tool for existing schedules is coming soon; your legacy schedules will keep working in the meantime. [Learn more](https://support.pagerduty.com/main/docs/shift-based-schedules-api-upgrade-examples).

Update an existing override.

Once the override has started, only `end_time` can be changed.

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error the PagerDuty server experienced an error.

schema.description: Generic error response from the PagerDuty API

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state of the server.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

Forbidden.description:
Caller is not authorized to view the requested resource.
While your authentication is valid, the authenticated user or token does not have permission to perform this action.

Unauthorized.description:
Caller did not supply credentials or did not provide the correct credentials.
If you are using an API key, it may be invalid or your Authorization header may be malformed.

event.effective_since: Date cannot be more than 12 months in the future

BadRequest.description: Bad Request — The request contains invalid parameters or data

errors.description:
Map of field path to list of validation messages for that field.
Field paths use dot notation prefixed by the resource type
(e.g. `event.effective_since`, `rotation.events`).

event.effective_since: Date cannot be more than 12 months in the future

OverrideShift.description:
Temporarily replaces a scheduled on-call member for a specific
time period. References either a `rotation_id` or a `custom_shift_id`
to identify the source shift being overridden (not both).

custom_shift_id.description: ID of the custom shift being overridden (mutually exclusive with rotation_id)

rotation_id.description: ID of the rotation whose shift is being overridden (mutually exclusive with custom_shift_id)

ShiftMember.description: A member (user) assigned to a shift or rotation slot

type.description:
`user_member` — a specific user is assigned.
`empty_member` — the slot is intentionally unassigned.

user_id.description: The ID of the user. Required when type is `user_member`.

UpdateOverrideRequest.description:
The request replaces the full override. Send every required field,
even the fields that do not change. An omitted `overridden_member`
is cleared.
